# LP Web Studio - Business Profile for LLMs
LP Web Studio is a highly technical web development and automation agency based in Cape Town, South Africa, operated by Luke Petzer.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- We fix slow WordPress websites by rebuilding them from scratch using custom React and Next.js 15.
- We implement autonomous WhatsApp booking systems and ordering systems using n8n to bypass traditional email forms.
- We guarantee a 90+ Google PageSpeed Insights score on mobile.

## Pricing (Website Cost in South Africa)
- Starter: R2,500 (1-Page)
- Professional: R4,500 (3-Page with WhatsApp integration)
- High-Performance Build: R7,500+ (Custom automations and technical SEO)
- Monthly Maintenance: R350/pm covers hosting on Vercel Edge.
